items.title: 3.13.3 fixes a wrong MAC computed when decrypting YAML sequences that contain a comment
items.body: 3.13.2 — the installed version — mis-computes the MAC, so any file encrypted by 3.13.1 or earlier with a comment on a list item fails to decrypt with "MAC mismatch". Upstream notes it also breaks integrations built on sops.

change.citation: Fix a bug introduced in 3.13.2 that computes a wrong MAC during decryption for sequences (YAML lists) that contain a comment (#2245)

local.statement: The defective binary is what runs here, so the upgrade is the fix rather than a change to step over. But nothing in these repos hands sops a file to decrypt: the sopsdiffer textconv driver is bound to no path, there is no .sops.yaml, no SOPS_* env var and no alias.

items.title: `sops completion` no longer emits a leading blank line before the shebang

change.citation: Fix `sops completion` emitting a leading newline before the shebang (#2253)

items.title: `ini` is now listed among the supported input/output types in the CLI help text

change.citation: Add `ini` to the list of supported types in the CLI help (#2239)

config_status.detail: The 3.13.2 → 3.13.3 delta is #2245, #2253 and #2239. None touches the sopsdiffer wiring or the Brewfile line, so the prior handling still holds.

items.title: ssh(1) use-after-free in the multiplexing client when a mux socket is torn down mid-request

change.citation: ssh(1): fix a use-after-free in the multiplexing client

local.statement: No ControlMaster is configured anywhere in these repos and no -R forwarding is set up, so the multiplexing path is never entered here.

evidence.note: the only ssh config this repo ships

items.title: sshd(8) `restrict` in authorized_keys now also disables tunnel forwarding

change.citation: sshd(8): the restrict keyword now includes tunnel forwarding

local.statement: launchd runs Apple's sshd on this machine, not Homebrew's, so a change to Homebrew's sshd(8) does not reach the running service.

items.title: ssh(1) gains -Z, printing the order in which agent keys are offered

change.citation: ssh(1): add a -Z option to print the order of agent key offers

local.statement: The 1Password agent here serves three vaults, so offer order is what decides which key a host sees first. -Z makes that inspectable rather than inferred.

items.title: The configure step now requires ECC and NISTP521 support in libcrypto

change.citation: OpenSSL builds now require ECC support including NISTP521

local.statement: Homebrew builds against its own OpenSSL, and nothing in these repos pins that formula, so whether the floor binds here is not decidable from the repos alone.

config_status.detail: No ssh client or server configuration is tracked in these repos beyond the 1Password agent's vault list.

items.title: `codex exec --full-auto` is removed; the flag now errors instead of running
items.body: The replacement is `--sandbox danger-full-access`, which is spelled differently and is not a rename the launcher can absorb silently.

local.statement: The Brewfile installs this cask, so the removed flag lands on the machine at the next upgrade whether or not anything invokes it today.

items.title: A cask upgrade re-quarantines the bundled native binding, so every invocation dies

change.citation: The published archive is notarized but the bundled native module is not stapled

local.statement: The quarantine flag has to be re-cleared after every cask upgrade here; nothing in setup.sh does it, so the next upgrade breaks the binary until someone clears it by hand.

evidence.note: the dispatch that would carry a quarantine task

config_status.detail: Nothing re-clears the cask quarantine after an upgrade.

suggestions.title: Add a `setup.sh quarantine` task so a plain cask upgrade can re-clear quarantine
suggestions.rationale: Four casks need the quarantine flag cleared after an upgrade and none of them has a home for it today.
